column1: What a magical place! If you are a lover of antiques this is the place to be!  But......  If you are a lover of antiques, magic, ambience, service and a holiday to remember for ever, this is not a place to stay.  Well, you may have better luck to tick these boxes but I did not!  1) I found the room that had not been cleaned to a standard of a 5* property let alone a 3*. Cobwebs, dust, insects (dead), ants in the rooms.  These faux pas noted within 5 minutes of walking into the rooms. 2) The bathroom was stocked with half used set of shampoo/bath wash. This was evidently leftover from the previous occupants of the room. 3) No turn down service. Guests were expected to arrange and open mosquito nets and remove the numerous pillows adorning the bed, because housekeeping is not…

I am sure once there the experience would be excellent, but beware in these troubled times, the cancellation policy is incorrect, no refund has been offered only credit towards another holiday, once again I have asked for a refund now communication has ceased no response to emails at all, think twice before booking
Food: breakfast had limited menu such as srilankan curry style or bacon and eggs,but waffel were said to be introduced soon
